turns.text: Thanks for coming in. I'll say what I'm here for: Owen's zero.
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Who gave Owen a zero, and did anyone speak to him before it went in?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
I'm not here to be reasonable. Did anyone speak to Owen before that zero went in?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side. Did anyone speak to Owen before the zero?
